scope: Read-only bounded portrait/manual audit of v27; writes only audit artifacts. All 103 IDs retained, not all reaudited. No SOTA or full feature-parity conclusion.

classification.A: Feasible bounded classical cloud-code work using current dependencies and authorized rights.
classification.B: Quality/features need selected and vetted new model/SDK/license or separate API/private-upload authorization.
classification.C: Real browser/WebView/device or authorized signing validation, not replaceable by controlled tests.

findings.title: Upgrade the existing alpha brush to precise replayable mask refinement
findings.present: Real keep/erase brush and undo already work; this is an upgrade, not adding a missing button.
findings.gap: Low-resolution raster-only edits and event-density-dependent painting fail the original-scale refinement requirement. No strength/hardness, edge contraction/expansion, or explicit fringe-color control.
recommended_bounded_scope: Keep the existing automatic raster mask as the immutable base; version source-bound normalized correction strokes and replay them at each render/export size.
Use event-density-invariant complete polyline sampling, opacity/strength and hardness; include cancel/undo, brush overlay and fully transparent/all-kept edge cases.
Add bounded deterministic edge shrink/grow as a separate alpha operation, with explicit limits; do not call feathering hair matting or claim automatic decontamination.
Update operation/project/backup validators and preserve legacy raster background operations. Test preview versus full export, geometry ordering, old project round-trip and work/memory rejection.
findings.not_claimed: This does not recover missed hair from a 256px segmenter or establish B01 matting quality.

findings.title: Complete classical liquify modes without losing existing geometry safety
findings.present: Push/restore, per-stroke selected-region restriction, source revision, fixed arc-length resampling and anti-fold bounds are already implemented.
findings.gap: No smooth/twirl/pinch/bloat command family or distinct editable freeze/unfreeze mask. Current selection is a partial protection mechanism, not absence of protection.
recommended_bounded_scope: Add one or two deformation modes under strict schema and retain the current geometric/Jacobian budget checks.
Make freeze/unfreeze a reusable user mask, separate from each stroke selection; preserve original-scale coordinates and undo.
Test zero displacement in frozen zones, no grid folding, repeated strokes, restore and export-scale replay.
findings.not_claimed: No promise of automatic body pose correction, semantic occluder protection or transparency-safe warping.

findings.title: Composite an imported photo behind the existing person alpha
findings.priority: smaller independent product gap after mask precision
findings.present: Pure color, transparent, background blur and ID-photo crop exist; general image overlay exists but composites on top.
findings.gap: No local imported-image background mode or fit/crop/position/background-asset persistence under the person matte.
recommended_bounded_scope: Reuse local image import and embedded-asset validation for user-selected backgrounds.
Composite behind the preserved foreground matte; save background positioning and assets in project/backup.
Test transparent pixels, hair-edge samples, fit/cover transforms, failure/cancel, source preservation and export replay.
findings.not_claimed: No generative background synthesis, relighting, automatic matching or guaranteed ID-photo compliance.

findings.title: Learned matting and semantic/retouch quality beyond the two existing models
findings.gap: The repository contains face_landmarker.task and selfie_segmenter.tflite only. No learned hair matte, full body/garment/teeth parsing, learned blemish classifier, reconstruction or true super-resolution path is present. Existing landmarks/heuristics cannot establish these quality claims.
findings.authorization_boundary: Classical/manual approximations can continue in A. A chosen additional model/runtime needs compatibility, provenance and license review before integration; paid SDK/API use, persistent credentials and private-photo uploads require their specific authorization. Do not treat a model name or downloaded weight as quality acceptance.
findings.quality_gate: Use licensed/public or specifically authorized fixtures, explicit failure cases and task metrics (e.g. alpha ground-truth error/gradient), not a single pleasing portrait or softened edge.
findings.note: Simple manual eye/teeth color controls need not require a new model; reliable automatic semantic selection and quality parity are the unresolved B claim.

findings.title: Current artifact browser, signed-install and real-device acceptance remains open
findings.gap: v27 has current unsigned compile/lint and controlled tests, not current signed-install, browser-render, WebView, real handset touch, SAF durable save/reopen, process-kill or memory/latency acceptance.
findings.authorization_boundary: Do not create a new signing key or use the denied no-sandbox browser route. Current audit did neither. Existing NativeCanvas/DOM reports cannot close this gate.
needed: Permitted functioning browser for CSS layout, actual canvas, pointer capture, pinch/zoom and import/edit/export end-to-end.
Authorized signing with preserved upgrade identity, then current-build WebView/device install and SAF checks.
Measured device memory/latency, background/process-death recovery and lowest-supported WebView compatibility.
findings.historical_evidence_rule: Keep earlier emulator/bridge smoke tied to its old signed artifact; it does not validate later v27 features.

additional_A_gap.title: User-painted protection/erase-back for beauty
additional_A_gap.note: The current face schema cannot save this user mask; adding one is useful but overlaps the mask-foundation work. Distinguish it from existing repair/local-tone selection.

mask_ui.finding: Actual person-mask keep/erase brush, mask view, 10-snapshot undo, cancellation rollback and background application already exist.

mask_precision.finding: Manual masks start at max side 256; bytes are destructively repainted with a fixed falloff. Radius is the only brush parameter, min UI radius 1%; no stroke recipe, strength, hardness, edge shrink/grow or decontamination controls. move caps interpolation at 40 dabs per event.

native_segmentation.finding: Only bundled selfie_segmenter.tflite is loaded for person separation; output is capped to side 256 and quantized from Float32 to 8-bit confidence.

background_render.finding: Background render only permits color, blur and transparent. Existing continuousAlpha input requires exact Float32 working pixels, but production portrait UI sends the byte-mask route. Feathering uses max(original, blurred alpha), not explicit shrink/grow or edge-color decontamination.

background_schema.finding: Saved background step permits bounded raster mask and color/blur/transparent fields, no normalized mask-stroke recipe or background image asset.

liquify_schema.finding: Liquify accepts only push/restore, with source-bound selection snapshots and actual displacement geometry bounds. Existing push already resamples by arc length. There are no smooth/twirl/pinch/bloat command types.

liquify_ui.finding: Only push/restore are exposed, with brush/lasso add/subtract/invert/feather selection. Those selections already protect pixels for saved strokes; not a complete persistent freeze/unfreeze workflow. Translucent source liquify is explicitly rejected.

overlay_composite.finding: Imported image is source-over foreground compositing. It is not a background image under a retained person matte.

portrait_schema.finding: Beauty controls are smooth/brighten/warmth/underEye/redness/lip/blush/palette; reshape slim/eyes/nose/jaw. Strict face record has no user-painted beauty protection/erase-back mask. Neighbor geometric protection is present.

skin_heuristic.finding: Skin eligibility uses landmark polygons and RGB/luminance heuristics, explicitly not learned parsing/retouch. Only seven classical beauty controls are advertised.

local_tone.finding: Already has up to 8 local tone layers, brush/lasso add/subtract selections, radial/linear masks, exposure in both signs, contrast/saturation/temperature, opacity, local undo. Do not relabel this as a missing dodge/burn feature.

runtime_scope.finding: Current v27 report records unsigned builds, no current install/runtime or real browser rendering. NativeCanvas/controlled DOM is explicitly not WebView acceptance. No new signer was created.

browser_limit.finding: Current v27 runtime gates remain open. Historical sandboxed Chromium failed before page load with Unix socket permission error. Historical signed emulator bridge smoke applies to earlier artifact, not current v27.

test_scope.finding: Pure runner deliberately excludes editor.test.cjs because it needs a real browser.

current_dependencies.finding: Current runtime dependency is the pinned MediaPipe Tasks Vision; debug signing only selected when MINT_TEST_KEYSTORE exists and release has no signing configuration.

probe.auditType: production PortraitUI start/move/finish executed in controlled Node VM, no browser
probe.conclusion: Current mask painting depends on pointer-event density; sparse long movement can leave holes even on the stroke centerline. This is an alpha-mask correctness/precision gap, not proof about actual device event frequency.

work_packages.title: 补草地、场景对象清理及局部材质修复
work_packages.acceptance: 只改选中材质；前景遮挡、地平线和投影保持，空泛通用提示词不算专用工具完成。

work_packages.title: RAW 解码、相机适配与 16-bit 广色域编辑
work_packages.acceptance: 用指定相机 RAW 样本逐种验收；处理链保持高位深，不是 8-bit 图标伪装 RAW。

work_packages.title: 色彩配置文件与 ICC 管理，sRGB/广色域导出
work_packages.acceptance: 灰阶/色卡和参考色彩转换逐项比；ICC 嵌入及 EXIF 方向正确，跨端不无故变色。

work_packages.title: 直方图、RGB/Lab 读数和曝光告警
work_packages.acceptance: 与像素统计真值一致；读取的是当前处理结果而非过期预览。

work_packages.title: 曝光、对比、高光/阴影、黑白场与白平衡吸管
work_packages.acceptance: 数值与显示一致，零值恒等；灰卡校准和高光压缩用测试图验算。

work_packages.title: 色阶、RGB 曲线与单色通道曲线
work_packages.acceptance: 控制点插值稳定，可撤销、复制、保存；预览与导出数值一致。

work_packages.title: HSL、颜色范围编辑、可选颜色及三向分级
work_packages.acceptance: 范围选择可预览，肤色与天空独立测试，颜色过渡不出现明显分段。

work_packages.title: 细节、锐化、颗粒、镜头调整、透视和校准
work_packages.acceptance: 分辨率改变后参数语义一致；镜头配置与图像方向正确，避免重复锐化。

work_packages.title: 一键校准、多图色彩统一和参考追色
work_packages.acceptance: 至少三种光照的同场组图对比；不靠全图 LUT 强行统一肤色或裁切高光。

work_packages.title: 逐人物、皮肤/眼口牙/发/衣物语义局部调色
work_packages.acceptance: 每类蒙版有准确率与边缘 QA；衣物/皮肤可独立控制，不将脸解析当全身解析。

v28_candidate_audit.summary: No dedicated control/semantic pipeline for full package in reviewed portrait schema; a manual implementation is possible without implying reliable learned selection.

work_packages.title: 天空、草地、水面、地面、建筑及宠物语义蒙版
work_packages.acceptance: 各类与混合场景分别评估；未支持类别要明示，不能通通当背景。

work_packages.title: 画笔、线性/径向渐变、色彩/亮度范围及蒙版加减
work_packages.acceptance: 坐标、羽化、加减/反选顺序可复现；多个蒙版叠加及同步行为有测试。

v28_candidate_audit.summary: Manual local tone already supports radial/linear/brush/lasso masks, add/subtract, exposure and layer opacity; automatic color/luminance-range selection not established.

work_packages.title: 滤镜、胶片/CCD 外观、强度、收藏与自定义预设
work_packages.acceptance: 同一预设有版本和参数；手机/电脑导出匹配，未授权资产不打包。

work_packages.title: 裁剪、旋转、翻转、比例、尺寸、参考线与透视
work_packages.acceptance: EXIF 旋转先规范化；输入输出尺寸准确，连续操作及撤销后无错位。

work_packages.title: 缩放、1比1、抓手、全屏、前后/参考对比
work_packages.acceptance: 缩放不改变数据；高分辨率局部检查真实像素，手势与画笔不冲突。

work_packages.title: 污点修复、选源修补与仿制图章
work_packages.acceptance: 三者独立且可选源；纹理/边缘无重复印章，支持源点和结果撤销。

v28_candidate_audit.summary: Manual source healing/clone and small facial automatic donor selection exist; not generative content-aware fill.

work_packages.title: 完整液化：推拉、重建、平滑、旋转、收缩、膨胀、冻结/解冻
work_packages.acceptance: 冻结区不动；变形网格不翻折，笔刷半径随原图尺度定义，可局部重建。

v28_candidate_audit.summary: Push/restore and protected selections exist; other liquify modes and dedicated freeze workflow absent.

work_packages.title: 矩形/椭圆/套索/画笔选区，反选和羽化
work_packages.acceptance: 相交/加减与边缘参数可保存；所有局部工具遵循同一选区坐标系。

v28_candidate_audit.summary: Manual core accepts brush/lasso add/subtract with inverse and feather; rectangle/ellipse commands are not accepted in this selection schema. Local-tone radial masks are not universal selection commands.

work_packages.title: 图像图层、移动缩放、顺序、蒙版与非破坏合成
work_packages.acceptance: 至少 20 层测试；图层可重新编辑，透明度与混合结果有参考图验证。

work_packages.title: 历史、撤销重做、独立版本和虚拟副本
work_packages.acceptance: 100 步编辑撤回一致；副本不改原片，模型候选接受后只新增一次历史。

work_packages.title: 文件/文件夹导入、项目重命名、搜索与增量导入
work_packages.acceptance: 100 张与目录嵌套测试；重名不覆盖，导入失败单独列出。

work_packages.title: 星标/旗标/色标、筛选排序、元数据与对比选片
work_packages.acceptance: 筛选不丢编辑；标签持久化，可按元数据追溯原片。

work_packages.title: AI 挑图：闭眼、曝光、相似组和质量筛选
work_packages.acceptance: 逐标签报准确率；人工可覆盖；绝不根据模型低分自动删除照片。

work_packages.title: 预设保存、导入导出、部分参数复制和批量同步
work_packages.acceptance: 参数有版本；人像按目标重新定位，不复制上一张坐标蒙版造成串位。

work_packages.title: 多图任务队列、进度、取消、失败隔离和恢复
work_packages.acceptance: 100 张压力测试；取消后不提交新结果，断点恢复不重复付费或覆盖。

work_packages.title: 可编辑项目、自动保存、崩溃恢复及素材路径重连
work_packages.acceptance: 模拟崩溃后恢复至最近确认编辑；原片不修改，资源丢失可重新定位。

v28_candidate_audit.summary: Only current v27 validation scope reviewed here; no new full functional or device acceptance.

work_packages.title: 自动化修图工作流和创意配方批量设计
work_packages.acceptance: 流程每步可追溯、可停；收费/联网步骤不得绕过授权，失败明确定位。

work_packages.title: 相机联机拍摄及边拍边修
work_packages.acceptance: 指定机型/固件/有无线链路验收；连接断开不损照片，不泛称支持所有相机。

work_packages.title: 云备份、多人协作、跨设备工程与回收站
work_packages.acceptance: 权限最小化、冲突处理、删除/恢复可验证；离线基础编辑不依赖云账号。

work_packages.title: 在线选片、分享交付与商业生态对接
work_packages.acceptance: 只分享选中成片；访问范围和有效期可配置，撤销后链接不可再访问。

work_packages.title: 原图尺寸输出与预览/正式渲染分离
work_packages.acceptance: 24MP 与大幅图保留指定尺寸；每一步原图级复算，不拿预览图直接保存。

v28_candidate_audit.summary: Only current v27 validation scope reviewed here; no new full functional or device acceptance.

work_packages.title: JPEG/PNG/TIFF、透明、品质与体积控制
work_packages.acceptance: 解码验证尺寸/alpha/位深；目标体积若仅近似需说明，失败不生成损坏文件。

v28_candidate_audit.summary: Only current v27 validation scope reviewed here; no new full functional or device acceptance.

work_packages.title: ICC/元数据保留或隐私剥离与 AI 处理来源记录
work_packages.acceptance: EXIF 方向正确；定位信息默认可去除；不得误称改过的照片仍为原始传感器 RAW。

work_packages.title: 目录结构、命名冲突、输出到新文件与完整导出清单
work_packages.acceptance: 原片 hash 始终不变；同名文件不静默覆盖，失败清单含原因和可重试项。

work_packages.title: 水印、多构图位置及带/无水印两版输出
work_packages.acceptance: 横竖方图位置正确；只添加用户授权水印，不移除他人版权标识。

work_packages.title: 证件照/普通照片排版、纸张尺寸 DPI 与打印
work_packages.acceptance: 毫米尺寸和像素换算可验；打印前预览，设备设置不被静默修改。

work_packages.title: 安装更新、无网可用、错误提示及资源释放
work_packages.acceptance: Windows 全新安装/卸载与 Android 权限拒绝/后台恢复测试；明确哪些工具必须联网。

v28_candidate_audit.summary: Only current v27 validation scope reviewed here; no new full functional or device acceptance.

work_packages.title: 文字字体、模板、收藏、描边阴影与排版控制
work_packages.acceptance: 字体授权可追踪；中文换行/缩放不截断，重新打开仍可编辑。

work_packages.title: 贴纸、边框、特效、素材搜索收藏与自定义素材
work_packages.acceptance: 多层贴纸不烘焙失去编辑；素材可删除，授权与离线缓存范围明确。

work_packages.title: 画笔、橡皮、取色、马赛克及局部涂绘
work_packages.acceptance: 撤销后像素一致；坐标精确，马赛克需足够不可辨而非仅轻度模糊。

work_packages.title: 拼图、自由拼、长图、间隔、圆角、画布与替换排序
work_packages.acceptance: 9 图及长图内存测试；替换/排序/裁剪独立，导出尺寸和内容完整。

work_packages.title: 手机相机、CCD 模拟、胶片效果及闪光质感
work_packages.acceptance: 前后摄像头真机测；权限拒绝可恢复，预览与成片一致；不伪造相机硬件能力。

work_packages.title: 实时美颜/妆容、白平衡、补光、网格与倒计时
work_packages.acceptance: 固定机型报帧率、延迟、温升和耗电；无机型前不承诺实时性能。

work_packages.title: Live/Motion Photo 导入、编辑、关键帧和保留动态导出
work_packages.acceptance: 指定厂商/机型格式分别测；照片/视频/音频关系完整，不能只输出静态 JPEG 冒充 Live。

work_packages.title: 视频/动效编辑与帧间一致，动态头发等扩展
work_packages.acceptance: 时间轴和声画同步；每帧脸型/妆容不闪跳；生成视频需独立费用与隐私确认。

work_packages.title: 作品管理、收藏、分享、跟拍模板和创作社区入口
work_packages.acceptance: 本地作品不等于可编辑工程；分享与发布需明确操作，不自动公开私人照片。
